scope: 25 derived still previews from5 existing original masters; no generation or painted border

actualVisualReview.sameHeroPartialImplementsInHeadCrop: Visible same-source clipped talisman/lotus/staff/ring/flame/shield fragments remain in rectangular head crops. These are deliberate crop previews, not isolated final head silhouettes. No program erasure to hide them.
actualVisualReview.bustLowerEdge: Lower clothing, staff shaft and earth shield end at intended rectangular bust boundary. Full implements remain available in full-body card preview.
actualVisualReview.readabilityAt128: All5 eye/face expressions, hair colors and identity adornments distinguishable at actual128; water head is smaller to preserve outward braid. User acceptance still pending.
